questions.question: Walk me through your role in a month-end close, including the journal entries, reconciliations, and review steps you owned as a Staff Accountant.
You prepared balance-sheet reconciliations by analyzing general-ledger activity. Can you describe a reconciliation issue you identified, how you investigated it, and how it was resolved?

This role requires standard costing and project-based costing in a manufacturing environment. What exposure have you had to inventory, pricing, cost information, or variance analysis, and how did you use that information?
Describe how you have analyzed P&L results to project future expenses. What data did you use, what assumptions did you make, and how did you communicate the results?
Give an example of an accounting process you set up or improved. What business need prompted the change, and what was the resulting impact on accuracy, efficiency, or documentation?
What experience do you have working under US GAAP, and how have you ensured that financial records and reporting were accurate and compliant?

This position will partner with Production and Engineering to investigate cost variances. How would you approach a significant unfavorable manufacturing cost variance that appears during month-end close?
Which ERP and reporting tools have you used, including Oracle and Hyperion? Please describe the accounting tasks you performed in those systems and your level of Excel proficiency.
Describe your experience supporting year-end audits. What schedules, reconciliations, or supporting documentation did you prepare, and how did you address auditor questions?

The role involves coordinating accounting activities across non-reporting departments and supervising accounting data-entry staff. Can you share an example of training colleagues or working with business partners to resolve an accounting issue or meet a deadline?
